review.why: Turn Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OpenDocument, EPUB and PDF files into clean Markdown with one command so the agent can read them.
review.summary: Runs the anydoc command through npx on a file or stdin and writes GitHub-flavored Markdown. Lists the supported formats and exit codes, advises on large files, and offers a hosted OCR option for scanned PDFs.
strengths: One command covers about twenty office, ebook and PDF formats; the format is detected from the content.
Documents exit codes and failure output so the agent can react to them.
Advises writing large conversions to a file and reading only the needed parts.
cautions: Runs npx -y @firecrawl/anydoc, which fetches an unpinned npm package at run time; the package itself was not reviewed here.
The optional hosted OCR mode sends the document to Firecrawl Parse; the default mode does no OCR.
Instruction-only skill; conversion quality on complex layouts was not tested.
